chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, has distributed your manners among you just as He has distributed your sustenance among you."

key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted; a formula of glorification for Allah

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe the distribution of character and sustenance among people?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that human moral dispositions are apportioned by Allah, just as worldly provision is apportioned by Him. The hadith highlights both divine wisdom in creation and the importance of recognizing differences in character as part of Allah’s decree.
